sentence: This project develops a method of preparing sequencing libraries that detects small RNAs of interest in human plasma with high sensitivity.
This project tests whether targeting two chemokine receptors protects heart cells from harm caused by the chemotherapy drug doxorubicin in mouse models.
This project studies how an RNA helicase controls translation when lipids are depleted.
This project studies the biological mechanisms that drive oral diseases.
This project studies why lung stem cells fail to regenerate in chronic lung diseases and instead repair the lung in a faulty way.
This project tries to find out whether early-life skin barrier and immune problems lead to atopic dermatitis and the allergic march.
This project studies how the lung keeps cell fate steady under mechanical strain from breathing and how injury and disease alter this.
This project studies how platinum chemotherapy changes lipid metabolism in small cell lung cancer and how this affects dendritic cells.
This project studies how a lysine methyltransferase protein guides early heart development in zebrafish, human embryonic stem cells and mice.
This project builds tools using nanotechnologies and microtechnologies to study extracellular vesicles in blood as biomarkers for early detection of Type 1 Diabetes.
This project studies how gut microbiota interact with microglia after traumatic brain injury.
This project tests therapies using nanoparticles and endothelial progenitor cells to restore microvascular integrity and prevent fibrotic lung remodeling.
This project looks for genes and signaling pathways that control tissue mechanics as the intestine forms in the embryo.
This project builds genetically encoded protein tools that exert precise forces inside cells to study how cells respond to mechanical forces.
This project studies a group of epithelial stem cells in the vocal fold and grows organoids to understand vocal fold health and disease.
This project tests ways to help people read digital breast tomosynthesis images faster or more accurately when screening for breast cancer.
This project studies the molecular signaling pathways behind inflammatory breast cancer, including the role of a transcription factor called basonuclin-1.
This project provides biostatistical and data management support for cancer research, including clinical trials and basic science experimental studies.
This project builds a nanopore tool that reads whole proteins one molecule at a time, including post-translational modifications.
This project studies cell and gene therapy, including genome editing, cell replacement and tissue engineering.
